entries.he: מִי שֶׁמִּתְבּוֹדֵד אֶת עַצְמוֹ וּבוֹדֵל אֶת עַצְמוֹ מִבְּנֵי־אָדָם, מִזְדַּקְּקִין עָלָיו מִלְמַעְלָה.
entries.en: 1. One who isolates himself and separates himself from others, they attend to him (to redress him for his sins) from Above.

entries.he: הַשִּׂיחָה שֶׁאָדָם מֵשִׂיחַ בֵּינוֹ לְבֵין קוֹנוֹ, הַשִּׂיחָה הַזֹּאת נַעֲשֵׂית אַחַר־כָּךְ גְּאֻלָּה וִישׁוּעָה לְבָנָיו.
entries.en: 1. The conversation that one conducts (privately) between him and his Creator, this conversation is made afterwards into a redemption and salvation for his children.
